svg.text: Frame: two 830 mm long sides, three 540 mm cross tubes (ends and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle), 20 x 20 x 1.5 mm; corner cleats and rivets. 830 x 580 mm.

svg.text: Fabric: reflective aluminized fabric, 830 x 580 mm, eyelets every

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 100 mm, laced round the frame, shiny side up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each, 30 mm from the bottom, for the M6 bolt into the frame tab.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 280 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm over both boxes; an angle clip and M6 wing bolt at each upright.
